seo.title: Tic-Tac-Toe Easy — Classic X and O for iPhone, No Ads
seo.description: The game you know, on a quiet board. Play the computer at Easy, Medium or Hard, or pass the phone to a friend. No ads, no accounts, nothing to buy.

note: Free · No ads · No account required

hero.label: BOARD GAME
hero.title: The classic game. A quiet board.
text: Tic-Tac-Toe Easy is the game you know, without the noise. Play the computer at three levels or pass the phone to a friend. No ads, no accounts, nothing to buy, and your scores stay on your iPhone.

items.title: Play the Computer
items.text: Easy takes a win when it sees one. Medium blocks your wins and sometimes plays its best. Hard plays a perfect game and never loses.

items.title: Play a Friend
items.text: Choose Friend and pass the phone back and forth. X goes first.

items.title: Go First or Second
items.text: Play X and start, or play O and let the computer open.

items.title: Your Win, in Color
items.text: The board is black and white. When someone gets three in a row, the line through it is drawn in your accent.

items.title: Scores & Streaks
items.text: Wins, losses and draws at each level, your current run of wins and your best one, and your two-player games.

items.title: Make It Yours
items.text: Light or Dark, Graphite or Black, and eight accents, each with its own app icon.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Just the game.
text: No ads, no analytics, no tracking and no account. Tic-Tac-Toe Easy makes no network requests, and your scores never leave your iPhone.

cta.title: Your move.
cta.text: Free, with no ads and no account required.
